model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е стълбовидна, показваща точността (%) на различни модели в три категории: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, като всяка категория има шест групирани стълба, представляващи различни комбинации от методи. Хоризонталната ос представлява трите категории, подредени по азбучен ред, а вертикалната ос показва точността в проценти, с диапазон от 50 до 62, разделяна на интервали от 2 единици. Като се използва легенда в горния десен ъгъл, всеки стълб е кодиран с различен визуален образ: син с диагонални линии (DAPO+Self-reflection), светлосин с хоризонтални линии (DAPO), оранжев с кръстосани линии (GRPO), зелен с вертикални линии (PPO+Self-reflection), оранжев с диагонални линии (SRPO) и светлозелен с диагонални линии (PPO). Всички стълбове са групирани по категория, като във всяка група са представени всички шест метода. В категорията Physics стълбовете достигат най-високите стойности, като най-високият е стълбът DAPO+Self-reflection със стойност около 61%, докато най-ниските стойности се наблюдават в категорията Mathverse, най-нисък стълб е DAPO със стойност около 53%. Във всеки от трите блока се вижда визуално различно разпределение на стойностите между методите, като в категорията Physics стълбовете са значително по-високи от тези в останалите две.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis presents the three domains as categorical labels, arranged from left to right in the order Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 2% (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Each domain on the horizontal axis contains a group of five vertically stacked bars, each corresponding to one of the models and distinguished by a unique pattern and color: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (orange with diagonal lines), DAPO (light blue with diagonal lines), PPPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and SRPO (light green with diagonal lines). The legend is positioned in the top-right corner, associating each pattern and color with its respective model. For the Mathverse domain, the accuracy values are approximately: DAPO+Self-reflection at 56%, GRPO at 54%, DAPO at 53%, PPPO+Self-reflection at 54%, and SRPO at 53%. In the MMLU domain, the values are approximately: DAPO+Self-reflection at 57%, GRPO at 56%, DAPO at 56%, PPPO+Self-reflection at 55%, and SRPO at 57%. For the Physics domain, the values are approximately: DAPO+Self-reflection at 61%, GRPO at 59%, DAPO at 58%, PPPO+Self-reflection at 59%, and SRPO at 61%. The bars within each group are arranged side-by-side in the order of the models as listed in the legend, and the chart does not appear to be sorted by value or feature any visual emphasis such as shadows or annotations.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major tick marks at 50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, and 62. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, five bars are grouped together, each corresponding to one model and distinguished by a unique color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (light blue with diagonal lines), GRPO (orange with diagonal lines), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and SRPO (light green with diagonal lines). In the Mathverse domain, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy (approximately 56%), followed by SRPO (around 55.8%), DAPO (about 53.2%), GRPO (around 53.5%), and PPO+Self-reflection (approximately 53.8%). In the MMLU domain, DAPO+Self-reflection again shows the highest accuracy (around 57%), followed by SRPO (approximately 57.2%), DAPO (about 55.8%), GRPO (around 55.6%), and PPO+Self-reflection (approximately 54.6%). In the Physics domain, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy (approximately 61%), followed by SRPO (around 60.5%), DAPO (about 57.5%), GRPO (around 58.2%), and PPO+Self-reflection (approximately 57.2%). The chart indicates that DAPO+Self-reflection consistently performs the best across all three domains, while DAPO generally performs the worst.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit in Prozent (%) für verschiedene Modelle auf drei verschiedenen Datensätzen: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Datensätze dar, die in alphabetischer Reihenfolge angeordnet sind, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent von 50 bis 62 anzeigt, mit einem Tick-Intervall von 2. Für jeden Datensatz sind fünf gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die jeweils einem Modell entsprechen: DAPO+Self-reflection (blauer Balken mit diagonalen Strichen), GRPO (orange Balken mit diagonalen Strichen), DAPO (hellblauer Balken mit diagonalen Strichen), PPPO+Self-reflection (grüner Balken mit diagonalen Strichen) und SRPO (orange Balken mit diagonalen Strichen). Die Balken sind in der Reihenfolge der Modelle angeordnet, wie sie in der Legende oben rechts aufgeführt sind. Die Balkenlängen variieren je nach Modell und Datensatz, wobei der höchste Balken bei Physics für DAPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 62 % liegt und der niedrigste Balken bei Mathverse für DAPO bei etwa 53 % liegt. Die Balken sind nicht hervorgehoben oder durch besondere visuelle Merkmale gekennzeichnet.
